stale_discharge_anchor.closure_effect: the anchor now covers the live fn [181,198] and still names the V1 inventory coordinate 125 as provenance. witness_rule.requirement: AGENTS.md section 22: a contract class must carry a per-call-site witness connecting that specific function-pointer slot to that specific contract
enforcement: provider_contract_witness(): the site's own field_offsets must contain the documented slot offset, the enclosing function must be the documented caller, and the writer symbols must be defined in the exact image
allocator_contract_witness(): the site's recorded seam must be MALLOC_FN/REALLOC_FN/FREE_FN, and both the hook global and CRYPTO_set_mem_functions must be defined in the exact image

apply_evidence_classes(): a site that matches an A1 name or an allocator seam but returns no witness keeps its resolver class, stays unresolved, and records contract_class_candidate plus a witness with contract_bounded=false
a site that arrives already carrying an ABI contract class without a valid witness is demoted to unclassified
contract_witness() is the only path that can set ABI_CONTRACT_PROVIDER or ABI_CONTRACT_ALLOCATOR
